description: This file defines the 'LogNode' interface, which standardizes a logging system's component that can output logs to various targets. It includes a single method 'println' for printing log data with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception details.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log data to a target. It supports chaining multiple log nodes by implementing the 'println' method, which takes log priority, tag, message, and an optional Throwable.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with the specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Intended to be implemented by classes that handle actual log output, facilitating chaining of multiple log handlers.
